title: FIFA/Coca-Cola Men's World Ranking — 2023 year-end review/held-out snapshot
scope: Official 2023 year-end senior men's ranking outcomes for the nine review countries and four held-out validation countries; exact country historical-page locators are preserved per observation.
limitations: Validation-only senior national-team outcome evidence. It is not a direct measure of domestic league depth and must not be used to fit the V2 professional ecosystem model.
